summary_md: **AgentsWatch ([@AgentsWatch](https://x.com/AgentsWatch/status/2116423961156174231))** summarizes Zettl and Gosmar ([arXiv 2610.37700](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37700)). A planner-coder-reviewer pipeline costs 3.22x and runs 3.24x longer than one strong call on 135 coding tasks while solving no more. A per-task oracle reaches 94.3% at half cost, but their actual router gets 71.4% at $0.0046.
